name: vercel-plugin
detect_check: plugin_inventory=$(claude plugin list --json) && printf '%s\n' "$plugin_inventory" | jq -e 'any(.[]; .enabled != false and ((.id // "") | split("@")[0] | . == "vercel" or . == "vercel-plugin"))' >/dev/null

shell_env_vars.name: VERCEL_PLUGIN_TELEMETRY
shell_env_vars.disables: Vercel plugin telemetry, including daily activity, first-use, version/install identifiers, agent-harness category and plugin skill events. Export in the environment that launches Claude Code, then restart that terminal/app session.

persistent_files.note: Random plugin installation UUID; opting out prevents creation of a new identifier but does not erase an existing one.
Daily telemetry throttle stamp. Report only, never delete.
First-use telemetry throttle stamp. Report only, never delete.
Recent plugin session marker used by Vercel CLI telemetry. Current plugin removes this marker when the opt-out is active; the skill itself does not delete it.

notes: Separate product from the Vercel CLI: VERCEL_TELEMETRY_DISABLED and vercel telemetry disable do not disable this plugin's telemetry.

detect_check queries Claude Code's installed-plugin inventory, including its active CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and requires an enabled vercel or vercel-plugin registration. Neither the vercel/claude binary alone nor leftover ~/.config/vercel-plugin files establish that this plugin is installed. If inventory retrieval fails, report detection as unverified; do not infer presence.

Verify in a fresh POSIX shell that launches Claude Code: test "${VERCEL_PLUGIN_TELEMETRY:-}" = off. A success in a different shell does not prove an already-running app inherited the setting. Windows: set the variable in the launching PowerShell environment or persist it with setx VERCEL_PLUGIN_TELEMETRY off, then restart the app/terminal.

Current upstream README (0.52.0 baseline) says prompt text, bash commands, tool-call contents, paths and project/account names are not collected. Earlier plugin builds behaved differently; inspect the installed version and update before assuming the current documented payload applies.
Other agent harnesses can also use the upstream plugin. This entry detects the Claude Code installation only; do not infer Cursor or Codex plugin installation from the Claude inventory.
